description: This file defines a handler class 'RecurringDepositAccountApplicationWithdrawnByApplicantCommandHandler' that processes withdrawal commands for recurring deposit accounts in the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and coordinates with the 'DepositApplicationProcessWritePlatformService' to execute application withdrawal logic within a transactional context.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountApplicationWithdrawnByApplicantCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles withdrawal commands for recurring deposit accounts, delegating to the deposit application service within a transactional context.

methods.name: RecurringDepositAccountApplicationWithdrawnByApplicantCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the deposit application process write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the withdrawal command by invoking the application service method for applicant withdrawal, using the command's entityId and JSON command.
